notes.li: Magic Framework 1.5.0 supports the new MF Vanilla 0.10.0 content pass with cleaner lifecycle pawn behavior for illusions, skeletons, and future constructed creatures.
Temporary lifecycle pawns can now vanish cleanly from combat without ordinary corpse, death-notification, or mourning side effects when content opts into that behavior.
Lifecycle render suppression is now routed through optional Visuals debug logging so normal play logs stay cleaner while nonstandard pawn graphics are still protected.

Magic Framework 1.4.0 expanded the first-party authoring surface with planar travel support, temporary allegiance effects, magical disease/treatment support, temporary wall spawning, and mining actions.
Maintained spell warmups, generated spell details, and temporary faction handling have been hardened for the new MF Vanilla content.
The main player-facing changes are in MF Vanilla 0.9.0: Planar Magic, Forbidden Lore spells, Geomancy utility spells, Cure Disease, and validated enchanted weapon behavior.
You can reopen the latest notes from the Magic Framework or MF Vanilla settings pages.
